interaction.web: The chevron button toggles a folder through the Collapsible; clicking a folder name or a file calls onSelect(path). The rows own the keys (the chevron and name button are tabIndex -1): Up/Down/Home/End move between visible rows, Right opens a folder or steps into it, Left closes it or steps out to the parent, Enter and Space select. FileTreeActions stops click and key events so an action does not select the row.
